useCase: Verifying 影 consistency を検出するために AI generation or image compositing
mechanism: 検出します 影 edges and estimates 影 direction vectors using 勾配 分析. チェックします that all 影s in the scene are consistent with a single (or known) light source configuration. AI images frequently produce 影s cast in contradictory directions or with inconsistent softness/hardness.
accuracy: 中 - 68-78% on images with clearly visible 影s
name: 影の整合性分析
source: Kee et al. (2013) - Exposing Digital Forgeries from Cast Shadows, ACM TOMM
algorithm: Shadow Edge Detection + Vanishing Point Analysis
parameters: Shadow 検出: chromaticity-based segmentation, Direction estimation: Radon transform on 影 boundaries, Consistency: pairwise angular comparison, Softness: penumbra width 分析
description: 分析します 影 geometry, direction, and softness for physical plausibility. AI models struggle to maintain consistent 影 casting from a single light source.

references.title: Kee, E. et al. (2013). Exposing Digital Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Shadows. ACM TOMM.
Zhang, W. et al. (2009). Detecting Image Splicing by Illumination Color Estimation. IWDW.

strengths:
• Physics-based approach with strong theoretical basis
• Effective for outdoor scenes with clear 影s
• Complements lighting 分析 methods
• Can detect both AI and manual 操作
limitations:
• Requires clearly visible 影 regions
• Overcast/indoor scenes with soft lighting are difficult
• Multiple light sources complicate 分析
• Transparent or translucent objects create complex 影s
